options.label: Clause in Rule 4 (Recommended)
options.description: An anchored paragraph inside Rule 4 'One copy per fact': a change's text about behaviour another item owns is a copy of that item's fact, so it gets a one-line pointer. It also cites Rule 5, since per-interpreter behaviour is a source fact. No second home, review-enforced like Rule 4, and it applies to docstrings too, which is where run A's claims sat.

options.label: New Rule 8
options.description: A numbered rule of its own with a link to Rules 4 and 5. It is easier to cite in a finding ('Rule 8'), but it opens a second home next to Rule 4 for a closely related fact, which the brief warns against.

options.label: Clause in Rule 5
options.description: Attach it to 'Source-code facts stay in source'. That fits per-interpreter detail, but Rule 5 is about values like signatures and defaults, and run A's dossier and migration-note claims were not code values.

options.label: Current master (Recommended)
options.description: Rebase the variant commit onto current master (f55d47557, with #1107, #1108 and #1109), force-push bk-418-ship-variant, update #1101's body and record the new SHAs.
